activities.description: Ordered comparable completed activities; labels are display-only and activity IDs are never matched by name.

event_id.description: Optional exact planned event ID; no event list search is performed.

athlete_id.description: Target athlete; defaults to selected athlete in coach mode, or the only athlete otherwise. Format: i12345 or 12345.

include_full.description: Include at most the first 200 normalized prescription/completed interval audit rows; never includes raw streams.

include_readiness.description: Include source-labelled daily wellness fields matched to each activity-local date.
